title: Formal Verification of Algebraic, Spectral, and One-Loop Entropy Bounds in Null-Cone Algebraic Quantum Gravity
abstract: We present a machine-checked arithmetic kernel and zero-float rational certificate suite (NULLCONE-QG-CERT-1.0) auditing the finite algebraic, rational-interval, and spectral-counting inequalities in Chandrasekaran's null-cone quantization of four-dimensional vacuum general relativity (arXiv:2611.34924v1). Our artifact comprises an 18-theorem constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel over N, Z, and constructive rationals Q (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier over Z and Q, 16 canonical JSON certificates (C01-C16), and 38 unit and forgery-rejection tests. Explicitly separating finite machine-checked identities from infinite-dimensional operator and continuum QFT steps, we audit four quantitative modes: rational partial-sum and 1/N tail enclosures for graviton pair creation versus O(G_N^3) harmonic divergence, causal diamond focusing and corner-boost suppression inequalities, marginally trapped surface clock ratios and exact Gauss-Bonnet arithmetic yielding q=257/302 and Sen's fixed-mass 106/45 coefficient, and ground-shifted reflecting AdS energy-band bounds (Z_beta = Tr(exp(-beta*(H-E_0)))) with finite rational Gram-matrix null superpositions.
